Looking for a fully funded PhD? Here are 10 trusted places to start your search: 1. FindAPhD - https://www.findaphd.com One of the largest databases for PhD opportunities across the UK, Europe, Australia, and beyond. 2. DAAD Scholarship Database (Germany) - https://www.daad.de/en A great resource for funded PhD opportunities and research scholarships in Germany. 3. EURAXESS - https://euraxess.ec.europa.eu Browse funded research positions and PhD vacancies across Europe. 4. Commonwealth Scholarships - https://cscuk.fcdo.gov.uk For students from eligible Commonwealth countries pursuing postgraduate study in the UK. 5. Fulbright Program - https://fulbrightprogram.org Offers funding for graduate study and research, particularly in the United States. 6. Erasmus Mundus - https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu Provides fully funded joint Master’s programmes and some doctoral opportunities across European universities. 7. University Websites - https://academicpositions.com Many universities advertise fully funded PhD positions directly on their careers or graduate research pages. 8. Academic Positions - https://academicpositions.com Lists funded PhD, postdoctoral, and research vacancies from universities around the world. 9. jobs.ac.uk A popular platform for PhD studentships and academic vacancies in the UK. 10. LinkedIn Many professors, research groups, and universities post funded PhD openings before they’re widely advertised.
